meta.label: GPCompaRe database statistics

sources.numbering: Residue segments and generic numbers: the full GPCRdb numbering (GPCRdb API fetched 2026-10-18). With it, 274 receptors carry an above-threshold contact at 3.50x50.
sources.cfr_set: The class-wide CFR set: the 50 top-ranked positions by CFR score.
sources.metadata: Ligand type and family from class_A_all.csv, as on the browse page.

meta.threshold_rule: Per receptor, contact pairs with |ΔRRCS| at or above mean + SD of |ΔRRCS| (at least 0.2), the threshold each report uses.
meta.sign: ΔRRCS = active minus inactive. Positive (red): stronger in the active model. Negative (blue): stronger in the inactive model.
meta.similarity: Pattern similarity: cosine over the signed 50-position CFR fingerprint (net ΔRRCS at each CFR position, 0 where there is no above-threshold contact). Receptors with fewer than 32 numbered CFR positions are left out. A browsing aid, not a classification.
meta.kruskal_scope: Kruskal-Wallis across families (or ligand types) with at least 4 receptors; a test of difference in distribution, not of any single family.

metrics.label: Above-threshold pairs
metrics.description: Contact pairs with |ΔRRCS| at or above the receptor threshold

metrics.label: Above-threshold pairs per 100 pairs
metrics.description: Above-threshold pairs per 100 contact pairs; less tied to receptor size than the sums

metrics.label: Sum |ΔRRCS|
metrics.description: Sum of |ΔRRCS| over all contact pairs; grows with receptor size and contact count

metrics.label: Share stronger in the active model
metrics.description: Share of above-threshold pairs whose RRCS is higher in the active model; depends on the threshold

metrics.label: CFR positions with an above-threshold contact
metrics.description: Of the 50 class-wide CFR positions, how many carry an above-threshold contact in this receptor
